subject: english
description: Past year questions on Tenses, Voice, Narration, Modals, Parts of Speech

questions.question: Fill in the blanks with correct tense: 'By the time we reached the station, the train ___ (already/leave).'
questions.solution:
'By the time we reached the station, the train **had already left**.'

Rule: Past perfect tense for the earlier action when two past actions are mentioned.
questions.knowledgeNote: Past perfect (had + V3) is used for the action completed before another past action.

questions.question: Change into passive voice: 'The teacher gave the students homework.'
questions.solution:
**Passive:** The students were given homework by the teacher.

Rule: Object becomes subject; verb becomes 'be + past participle'; original subject becomes 'by + agent'.
questions.knowledgeNote: Double object sentences: either object can become subject in passive voice.

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: She said, 'I am very happy.'
questions.solution:
**Indirect:** She said that she was very happy.

Rules applied: 'said' stays; tense shifts (present → past); 'I' → 'she'.
questions.knowledgeNote: If reporting verb is in present tense, no tense change is needed in reported speech.
